description: Download a foreign-language movie/video (or take a local file), transcribe and translate it to English with WhisperX, and recreate the video with English subtitles. Use on requests like "get English subs for this", "translate this movie", "subtitle this YouTube film". Fully local: yt-dlp → WhisperX → ffmpeg.
